01 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

The product matters.
So does the code.

I care about the people using the product and the team building it.

I started building mobile apps in 2015. Since then, I’ve worked across financial platforms, enterprise tools, and full-stack applications, taking on everything from interfaces and microservices to production operations.

My approach is practical: understand the problem, make the code easy to change, and test what matters. I enjoy working with product and design, shaping technical foundations, and helping other engineers find their footing.
